title: The Painted Skin
synopsis: Chen Wen’s husband Wang Sheng is getting himself into a lot of trouble.

fullText.simplified:
王生的妻子陈文觉得丈夫最近很奇怪。
    王生是一个书生，他每天都会去书房读书。那个时候，只有男人能去读书，而且读书很重要。只有读书好，才能考试考得好。只有考试考得好，才能当官。只有当官，才能有好的生活。所以那个时候，很多书生都为了能当官，努力地读书；很多妻子也都希望自己的丈夫能好好读书，好好考试，当上官，让家里过上好的生活。
    王生也一样，他每天都会去书房读书。他的妻子陈文希望他能好好读书，又怕家里不安静，他不能好好读书，所以为王生在城南买了一个书房。王生的书房在城南，家在城北，书房和家离得很远。
    王生每天的生活都差不多。早上吃过早饭后，他就去书房读书。中午陈文会给他送饭。到了下午五点，王生就会回家。王生不是一个喜欢读书的人，他爱玩。每天都是陈文叫他快点出门去书房，而且很多时候，下午没到五点王生就跑回家了。他总是说，读书太累了，不好玩！
    但是，最近陈文觉得丈夫变了。早上，他不用陈文叫他出门，而是自己早早地出门，早饭也不在家里吃了。他把早饭带到书房吃，说是为了能更早地读书，读更多的书；中午，他也不让陈文给他送饭了，而是在早上出门的时候就把午饭带上，说是不想让陈文太累；下午，他也不会不到五点就跑回家了，而是很晚才回家。
    丈夫为什么要那么早出门，又那么晚回来呢？他真的是一直在书房看书吗？他为什么中午不要我送饭了呢？陈文心里有很多问题，所以她决定偷偷去书房看看丈夫。
fullText.traditional:
王生的妻子陳文覺得丈夫最近很奇怪。
    王生是一個書生，他每天都會去書房讀書。那個時候，只有男人能去讀書，而且讀書很重要。只有讀書好，才能考試考得好。只有考試考得好，才能當官。只有當官，才能有好的生活。所以那個時候，很多書生都為了能當官，努力地讀書；很多妻子也都希望自己的丈夫能好好讀書，好好考試，當上官，讓家裡過上好的生活。
    王生也一樣，他每天都會去書房讀書。他的妻子陳文希望他能好好讀書，又怕家裡不安靜，他不能好好讀書，所以為王生在城南買了一個書房。王生的書房在城南，家在城北，書房和家離得很遠。
    王生每天的生活都差不多。早上吃過早飯後，他就去書房讀書。中午陳文會給他送飯。到了下午五點，王生就會回家。王生不是一個喜歡讀書的人，他愛玩。每天都是陳文叫他快點出門去書房，而且很多時候，下午沒到五點王生就跑回家了。他總是說，讀書太累了，不好玩！
    但是，最近陳文覺得丈夫變了。早上，他不用陳文叫他出門，而是自己早早地出門，早飯也不在家裡吃了。他把早飯帶到書房吃，說是為了能更早地讀書，讀更多的書；中午，他也不讓陳文給他送飯了，而是在早上出門的時候就把午飯帶上，說是不想讓陳文太累；下午，他也不會不到五點就跑回家了，而是很晚才回家。
    丈夫為什麼要那麼早出門，又那麼晚回來呢？他真的是一直在書房看書嗎？他為什麼中午不要我送飯了呢？陳文心裡有很多問題，所以她決定偷偷去書房看看丈夫。

sentences.simplified: 王生的妻子陈文觉得丈夫最近很奇怪。
sentences.traditional: 王生的妻子陳文覺得丈夫最近很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: wáng shēng de qī zi chén wén jué de zhàng fu zuì jìn hěn qí guài
sentences.english: Wang Sheng’s wife Chen Wen thought that her husband has been acting very strange lately.

sentences.simplified: 王生是一个书生，他每天都会去书房读书。
sentences.traditional: 王生是一個書生，他每天都會去書房讀書。
sentences.pinyin: wáng shēng shì yí ge shū shēng tā měi tiān dōu huì qù shū fáng dú shū
sentences.english: Wang Sheng was a scholar, and he went to his studio to study every day.

sentences.simplified: 那个时候，只有男人能去读书，而且读书很重要。
sentences.traditional: 那個時候，只有男人能去讀書，而且讀書很重要。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge shí hou zhǐ yǒu nán rén néng qù dú shū ér qiě dú shū hěn zhòng yào
sentences.english: At that time, only men could study, and studying was also very important.

sentences.simplified: 只有读书好，才能考试考得好。只有考试考得好，才能当官。
sentences.traditional: 只有讀書好，才能考試考得好。只有考試考得好，才能當官。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu dú shū hǎo cái néng kǎo shì kǎo de hǎo zhǐ yǒu kǎo shì kǎo de hǎo cái néng dāng guān
sentences.english: You had to study well to do well in the exam. You had to do well in the exam to become a government official.

sentences.simplified: 只有当官，才能有好的生活。
sentences.traditional: 只有當官，才能有好的生活。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu dāng guān cái néng yǒu hǎo de shēng huó
sentences.english: You had to be a government official to be able to have a good life.

sentences.simplified: 所以那个时候，很多书生都为了能当官，努力地读书；
sentences.traditional: 所以那個時候，很多書生都為了能當官，努力地讀書；
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ nà ge shí hou hěn duō shū shēng dōu wèi le néng dāng guān nǔ lì de dú shū
sentences.english: So at that time, many scholars studied diligently in order to serve as government officials.

sentences.simplified: 很多妻子也都希望自己的丈夫能好好读书，好好考试，当上官，
sentences.traditional: 很多妻子也都希望自己的丈夫能好好讀書，好好考試，當上官，
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō qī zi yě dōu xī wàng zì jǐ de zhàng fu néng hǎo hǎo dú shū hǎo hǎo kǎo shì dāng shàng guān
sentences.english: Many wives also hoped that their husbands would study well, do well in the exam, become a government official, ..

sentences.simplified: 让家里过上好的生活。
sentences.traditional: 讓家裡過上好的生活。
sentences.pinyin: ràng jiā lǐ guò shàng hǎo de shēng huó
sentences.english: .. and give their family a better life.

sentences.simplified: 王生也一样，他每天都会去书房读书。
sentences.traditional: 王生也一樣，他每天都會去書房讀書。
sentences.pinyin: wáng shēng yě yí yàng tā měi tiān dōu huì qù shū fáng dú shū
sentences.english: Wang Sheng was the same, he would go to his studio every day to study.

sentences.simplified: 他的妻子陈文希望他能好好读书，又怕家里不安静，他不能好好读书，
sentences.traditional: 他的妻子陳文希望他能好好讀書，又怕家裡不安靜，他不能好好讀書，
sentences.pinyin: tā de qī zi chén wén xī wàng tā néng hǎo hǎo dú shū yòu pà jiā lǐ bù ān jìng tā bù néng hǎo hǎo dú shū
sentences.english: His wife Chen Wen hoped that he would study well. She worried that it wasn’t quiet at home and he couldn’t study well.

sentences.simplified: 所以为王生在城南买了一个书房。
sentences.traditional: 所以為王生在城南買了一個書房。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ wèi wáng shēng zài chéng nán mǎi le yí ge shū fáng
sentences.english: So they bought a studio for Wang Sheng in the south part of town.

sentences.simplified: 王生的书房在城南，家在城北，
sentences.traditional: 王生的書房在城南，家在城北，
sentences.pinyin: wáng shēng de shū fáng zài chéng nán jiā zài chéng běi
sentences.english: Wang Sheng’s studio was in the south part of town, and his house was in the north part of town.

sentences.simplified: 书房和家离得很远。
sentences.traditional: 書房和家離得很遠。
sentences.pinyin: shū fáng hé jiā lí de hěn yuǎn
sentences.english: It was very far between his studio and his house.

sentences.simplified: 王生每天的生活都差不多。早上吃过早饭后，他就去书房读书。
sentences.traditional: 王生每天的生活都差不多。早上吃過早飯後，他就去書房讀書。
sentences.pinyin: wáng shēng měi tiān de shēng huó dōu chà bu duō zǎo shang chī guò zǎo fàn hòu tā jiù qù shū fáng dú shū
sentences.english: Wang Sheng’s daily life was pretty much the same. After eating breakfast in the morning, he went to study in his studio.

sentences.simplified: 中午陈文会给他送饭。到了下午五点，王生就会回家。
sentences.traditional: 中午陳文會給他送飯。到了下午五點，王生就會回家。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng wǔ chén wén huì gěi tā sòng fàn dào le xià wǔ wǔ diǎn wáng shēng jiù huì huí jiā
sentences.english: At midday, Chen Wen would send him food. Wang Sheng would return home at 5 pm.

sentences.simplified: 王生不是一个喜欢读书的人，他爱玩。
sentences.traditional: 王生不是一個喜歡讀書的人，他愛玩。
sentences.pinyin: wáng shēng bú shì yí ge xǐ huan dú shū de rén tā ài wán
sentences.english: Wang Sheng wasn’t someone who liked to study; he liked to have fun.

sentences.simplified: 每天都是陈文叫他快点出门去书房，而且很多时候，下午没到五点王生就跑回家了。
sentences.traditional: 每天都是陳文叫他快點出門去書房，而且很多時候，下午沒到五點王生就跑回家了。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān dōu shì chén wén jiào tā kuài diǎn chū mén qù shū fáng ér qiě hěn duō shí hou xià wǔ méi dào wǔ diǎn wáng shēng jiù pǎo huí jiā le
sentences.english: Every day Chen Wen would hurry him out the door to his studio, but very often Wang Sheng would come home before 5 pm.

sentences.simplified: 他总是说，读书太累了，不好玩！
sentences.traditional: 他總是說，讀書太累了，不好玩！
sentences.pinyin: tā zǒng shì shuō dú shū tài lèi le bù hǎo wán
sentences.english: He always said that studying was very tiresome and no fun!

sentences.simplified: 但是，最近陈文觉得丈夫变了。
sentences.traditional: 但是，最近陳文覺得丈夫變了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zuì jìn chén wén jué de zhàng fu biàn le
sentences.english: But recently Chen Wen felt that her husband had changed.

sentences.simplified: 早上，他不用陈文叫他出门，而是自己早早地出门，
sentences.traditional: 早上，他不用陳文叫他出門，而是自己早早地出門，
sentences.pinyin: zǎo shang tā bú yòng chén wén jiào tā chū mén ér shì zì jǐ zǎo zǎo de chū mén
sentences.english: In the morning, he didn’t need Chen Wen to tell him to get out of the door, but instead left very early by himself.

sentences.simplified: 早饭也不在家里吃了。
sentences.traditional: 早飯也不在家裡吃了。
sentences.pinyin: zǎo fàn yě bú zài jiā lǐ chī le
sentences.english: He didn’t even eat breakfast at home.

sentences.simplified: 他把早饭带到书房吃，说是为了能更早地读书，读更多的书；
sentences.traditional: 他把早飯帶到書房吃，說是為了能更早地讀書，讀更多的書；
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ zǎo fàn dài dào shū fáng chī shuō shì wèi le néng gèng zǎo de dú shū dú gèng duō de shū
sentences.english: He took his breakfast to eat in the studio, saying it was so he could start studying earlier and read even more books.

sentences.simplified: 中午，他也不让陈文给他送饭了，
sentences.traditional: 中午，他也不讓陳文給他送飯了，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng wǔ tā yě bú ràng chén wén gěi tā sòng fàn le
sentences.english: He also didn’t let Chen Wen send him food at midday.

sentences.simplified: 而是在早上出门的时候就把午饭带上，说是不想让陈文太累；
sentences.traditional: 而是在早上出門的時候就把午飯帶上，說是不想讓陳文太累；
sentences.pinyin: ér shì zài zǎo shang chū mén de shí hou jiù bǎ wǔ fàn dài shàng shuō shì bù xiǎng ràng chén wén tài lèi
sentences.english: Instead, he took his lunch with him when he went out in the morning, saying that he didn’t want to tire out Chen Wen.

sentences.simplified: 下午，他也不会不到五点就跑回家了，而是很晚才回家。
sentences.traditional: 下午，他也不會不到五點就跑回家了，而是很晚才回家。
sentences.pinyin: xià wǔ tā yě bú huì bú dào wǔ diǎn jiù pǎo huí jiā le ér shì hěn wǎn cái huí jiā
sentences.english: In the afternoon, he no longer came home before 5 pm. He came home only when it was very late.

sentences.simplified: 丈夫为什么要那么早出门，又那么晚回来呢？
sentences.traditional: 丈夫為什麼要那麼早出門，又那麼晚回來呢？
sentences.pinyin: zhàng fu wèi shén me yào nà me zǎo chū mén yòu nà me wǎn huí lái ne
sentences.english: Why does my husband want to go out so early, and come back so late?

sentences.simplified: 他真的是一直在书房看书吗？他为什么中午不要我送饭了呢？
sentences.traditional: 他真的是一直在書房看書嗎？他為什麼中午不要我送飯了呢？
sentences.pinyin: tā zhēn de shì yì zhí zài shū fáng kàn shū ma tā wèi shén me zhōng wǔ bú yào wǒ sòng fàn le ne
sentences.english: Is he really studying in the studio the whole time? And why doesn’t he want me to send him food at midday?

sentences.simplified: 陈文心里有很多问题，所以她决定偷偷去书房看看丈夫。
sentences.traditional: 陳文心裡有很多問題，所以她決定偷偷去書房看看丈夫。
sentences.pinyin: chén wén xīn li yǒu hěn duō wèn tí suǒ yǐ tā jué dìng tōu tōu qù shū fáng kàn kan zhàng fu
sentences.english: Chen Wen had a lot of questions on her mind, so she decided to secretly go to the studio to check on her husband.

sentence_translations: Wang Sheng’s wife Chen Wen thought that her husband has been acting very strange lately.
Wang Sheng was a scholar, and he went to his studio to study every day.
At that time, only men could study, and studying was also very important.
You had to study well to do well in the exam. You had to do well in the exam to become a government official.
You had to be a government official to be able to have a good life.
So at that time, many scholars studied diligently in order to serve as government officials.
Many wives also hoped that their husbands would study well, do well in the exam, become a government official, ..
.. and give their family a better life.
Wang Sheng was the same, he would go to his studio every day to study.
His wife Chen Wen hoped that he would study well. She worried that it wasn’t quiet at home and he couldn’t study well.
So they bought a studio for Wang Sheng in the south part of town.
Wang Sheng’s studio was in the south part of town, and his house was in the north part of town.
It was very far between his studio and his house.
Wang Sheng’s daily life was pretty much the same. After eating breakfast in the morning, he went to study in his studio.
At midday, Chen Wen would send him food. Wang Sheng would return home at 5 pm.
Wang Sheng wasn’t someone who liked to study; he liked to have fun.
Every day Chen Wen would hurry him out the door to his studio, but very often Wang Sheng would come home before 5 pm.
He always said that studying was very tiresome and no fun!
But recently Chen Wen felt that her husband had changed.
In the morning, he didn’t need Chen Wen to tell him to get out of the door, but instead left very early by himself.
He didn’t even eat breakfast at home.
He took his breakfast to eat in the studio, saying it was so he could start studying earlier and read even more books.
He also didn’t let Chen Wen send him food at midday.
Instead, he took his lunch with him when he went out in the morning, saying that he didn’t want to tire out Chen Wen.
In the afternoon, he no longer came home before 5 pm. He came home only when it was very late.
Why does my husband want to go out so early, and come back so late?
Is he really studying in the studio the whole time? And why doesn’t he want me to send him food at midday?
Chen Wen had a lot of questions on her mind, so she decided to secretly go to the studio to check on her husband.
